## Choosing a self storage facility in Bangalore? Check security, insurance, pricing, pickup and tracking with this simple guide before you book.


## **Choosing a Self Storage Facility in Bangalore**


Six things must be evaluated when selecting a **[self storage facility in Bangalore](https://stownest.com/self-storage-bangalore?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website+&utm_campaign=How+to+Choose+a+Self+Storage+Facility+in+Bangalore)** . These are: how the facility safeguards customer belongings (security), what is covered by the facility's insurance, whether pricing is by item or by unit, how do the facility track customer's belongings, how does the facility provide access to customer's belongings, and how does the company handle customer's belongings if the belongings are damaged. A good facility provides this information in writing to the customer. If the facility you're considering cannot provide this information, keep looking.


## **Why This Choice Matters More Than It Seems**


A **[self storage facility](https://stownest.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website+&utm_campaign=How+to+Choose+a+Self+Storage+Facility+in+Bangalore)** is something you don't often think about. Most of the time, people pick a storage facility the way they pick a restaurant on a busy night. They quickly search, and then look at the first result, and then pick the one that looks okay.


While a bad restaurant may result in an uncomfortable meal or a long wait, a bad storage facility means someone else is in control of your belongings for an extended period of time. Once your belongings are stored, you can't keep an immediate check on them.


In Bangalore, this can make the process of selecting a storage facility difficult. The city is very large. Many of the facilities can be very far from other facilities that are closer on a map. Also, many of us live in apartments. This means we may need to plan ahead of time in order to leave our belongings to be stored. So finding the storage facility that is convenient and fits how we normally live, may be more important than price.


### **Here's a practical way to make your decision.**


How secure is the storage? What does the security actually look like? Is the warehouse monitored by CCTV all day and all night or only during business hours? Who has access to the storage area? Is there a log in or out system for access to the storage area?


StowNest has 24/7 CCTV monitoring of the warehouse.


## **What does the Insurance Actual Cover?**


"Your items are insured" is probably the most useless sentence in storage. The important questions are how much are your items insured for? What are they insured against? How do you make a claim?


At **[StowNest](https://stownest.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website+&utm_campaign=How+to+Choose+a+Self+Storage+Facility+in+Bangalore)** , if your items are worth more than a facility's limit or you want to know how to make a claim, ask before you book and get the answer in writing.


## **Know How Pricing Works**


Many people pay too much for storage because they don't know how the pricing works.


There are facilities that charge the same monthly rate for a storage unit no matter how much space you use. Would you pay for a storage unit big enough to hold all your furniture, including a big bed, if all you were storing was a sofa?


StowNest prices storage based on the number of items you store, unlike other providers who price based on a fixed unit size. The easiest way to compare options is to give each provider the same approximate list of items, and the same time period, and compare the quotes side by side.


## **Check How Your Belongings Are Tracked**


Ask how the facility knows what is yours. If the facility staff tells you they “keep it all together,” this should raise a flag. If you want a specific box back after a few months, staff should be able to identify it.


At StowNest, each item is barcoded, and there is a trail of every item stored. Through the app, you can view your items, including photos and videos.


### **Look At Pest Control & Conditions**


Unused fabric and paper can get damaged due to the presence of pests. Bangalore has a milder climate than other cities, but pests are attracted to humid, and undisturbed, areas.


At the StowNest warehouse, pest control is performed regularly, and the warehouse is monitored 24/7.


### **Pickup, Delivery and Access**


Consider pick up and delivery times. Traditional storage means you have to load and unload a vehicle multiple times, and you'll need to do this again when you want your items back. Heavy traffic can make this process take a long time.


Another option is pickup and delivery storage, whereby you call customer support to provide details of what you want stored and our team collects it from your home. To retrieve it, you also have to call customer support to request for a delivery. You are at liberty to visit the warehouse to retrieve your goods, but you have to notify customer support in advance.


For customers in apartments, do check your society's pick up rules for example, lifts booking and timing a few days in advance.


### **Find Out What Happens If Something Gets Damaged**


Although we handle all items with care, sometimes, things happen and damages occur. The main concern is what happens next?


At StowNest, if anything gets damaged during storage or transit, we take full responsibility to either repair or replace it. A good facility should give you a clear answer, not a shrug.


### **Check That The Company Is Real And Easy To Reach**


Look for a company that is easy to reach, with recent reviews that mention the same things repetitively and an answer to your question before you make a payment. A facility that's hard to reach before you book, is rarely easier to reach after your booking.


### **Find Out What You Can't Store**


Ask in advance if you're not sure of an item. Standard items accepted are household furniture, boxes, mattresses, appliances and other seasonal items.


## **A Simple List of Questions to Ask Any Provider**


Ask these questions before making your final decision:


-


How is your facility monitored, and is it monitored 24/7?


-


What does my insurance cover, and how much does it cover? How do I make a claim?


-


Is pricing based on cubic feet, or by the items stored?


-


How are my items tracked, and can I view them online?


-


How does your pick-up and delivery service work? Can I do a pick-up or drop off myself?


-


What happens if an item gets damaged?


-


What can’t I store?


If you are given prompt and clear answers to the questions, that’s a great sign.


## **Traditional Facility or Pickup and Delivery?**


Neither of these is wrong. Traditional storage is more suitable to a person who has a vehicle, a lot of time and a lot of stuff to store for a long time. Pick up and Delivery storage is ideal for someone who is extremely busy, has large and heavy items, no vehicle and doesn’t want to spend time in traffic to and from Bangalore. Choose based on what works best for you.


## **What Good Choice Looks Like**


You’ll know you’ve chosen well when you have a clear understanding of exactly what you’re paying for, what’s protected and how, and what happens in case something goes wrong. Most importantly, you’ll feel that it’s easy to get your stuff back. That’s the real test of a good storage facility in Bangalore.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. What should I look for when finding a self storage facility in Bangalore?**


Look at security, insurance, pricing, tracking, pickup and access and how damage is dealt with. A good facility should cover all of these.


**2. What should a storage facility in Bangalore include for security?**


Look for round the clock CCTV surveillance, and access control. At StowNest, the warehouse is monitored by CCTV 24/7.


**3. Is pricing for household storage in Bangalore by item or by unit?**


Pricing depends on the provider. At StowNest, pricing is by the items you store, not by a fixed unit size, so you aren't paying for unit size you don't need.


**4. Can I get pickup and delivery for furniture storage in Bangalore?**


Yes. StowNest can pick up your furniture from your home and deliver it back to you. You can also visit the warehouse if it's arranged in advance through Customer Support.


**5. How will I know what's in my self-storage in Bangalore?**


Everything at StowNest is barcode-tracked and you can also access photos and videos of your items in the StowNest app.


**6. Is there temporary storage in Bangalore for a few weeks?**


Yes,[Short-term storage](https://stownest.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website+&utm_campaign=How+to+Choose+a+Self+Storage+Facility+in+Bangalore) is commonly requested for storage during moves, renovations and for Festivals. Be sure to let Customer Support know your situation when you book storage.


**7. What happens if my belongings are damaged at a storage facility in Bangalore?**


If your belongings are damaged due to transportation or storage, StowNest will take responsibility of repairing or replacing it.


**8. What should I ask before I book safe storage in Bangalore?**


You need to ask about monitoring, insurance and claims, pricing, tracking, pickup and access, pest control, what you are not allowed to store and what you are allowed to store. Get answers for all these in writing.
